# Anne Shirley & Davy Keith

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — fond companion · since v2  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home through the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and meets [Diana](../character/diana.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing. After searching the well with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). After [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) breaks down in tears over his falsehoods, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reprimand him, send him to bed, and later laugh over his antics.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to do household chores while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes to help Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). While transferring bed feathers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly applies rug dye to her nose instead of freckle lotion, turning it bright red just before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) wash off the dye and supplies a roast chicken, allowing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to successfully entertain her visitors with a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's long-lost wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived at his house. The news spreads quickly through the neighborhood, with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigating the situation. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who admits he is glad his wife has returned and prepares to explain their past separation.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal
